# Catalog

<!-- Generated by scripts/catalog_case_builds.py from catalog/case-builds.json. Do not edit by hand; run `make catalog`. -->

This page indexes the 29 casebook case builds in [`examples/`](examples/) (20 text, 9 voice), the patterns they reuse, and the rest of the repository. Each case build is one live Rasa Mantle agent for one scenario from the [AI team casebook](tutorials/rasa-ai-team-casebook/), run through scripted conversations whose outcomes are read from the tracker. The same data is in [`catalog/case-builds.json`](catalog/case-builds.json).

- **Result** is the build's main run as its README names it: conversations passed over conversations run, from that run's `results.json`.
- **Article** links the build's case on rasa.community once that article is published (publication state read from `RasaHQ/rasa-community` at `15afa7c`, 2026-09-30).

Jump to: [by industry](#by-industry) · [by vendor stack](#by-vendor-stack) · [patterns and reusable parts](#patterns-and-reusable-parts) · [tutorials and other examples](#tutorials-and-other-examples)

## Patterns and reusable parts

- [`patterns/voice-vendor-router`](patterns/voice-vendor-router/): **the voice vendor router.** Swap and fail over between ASR/TTS vendors so one provider outage cannot mute or deafen a live call. Its README lists 17 ASR and TTS engines; live-verified: Deepgram, Rime, OpenAI, Speechmatics, Vosk, faster-whisper, Neuphonic NeuTTS-2E. Case builds that load its adapters directly: [`mantle-voice-banking-dispute-claude`](examples/mantle-voice-banking-dispute-claude/), [`mantle-voice-healthcare-refill-request-gpt-local`](examples/mantle-voice-healthcare-refill-request-gpt-local/).
- [`patterns/voice-auth-stepup`](patterns/voice-auth-stepup/): Risk-tiered authentication step-up: low/medium/high driven by the action attempted, not by the caller.
- [`patterns/voice-handoff-context`](patterns/voice-handoff-context/): Hand a caller to a human as a state transfer: a structured context package with a derived summary, an allowlist governing what crosses, and a fixture agent desk that reconstructs the caller.
- [`patterns/session-start-personalization`](patterns/session-start-personalization/): Personalize every conversation by resolving identity once, at session start, into shared project memory.
- [`patterns/evaluation-harness`](patterns/evaluation-harness/): Measure whether a change to an agent helped, using assertions, dialogue understanding tests, and LLM-as-a-judge scoring.
- [`scripts/case_builds/`](scripts/case_builds/): the shared case-build harness. `run_build.py` trains and starts a build, drives its scripted conversations over REST or through `voice_driver.py` (browser audio), reads each outcome from the tracker, and records results and spend. Also `render_caller_audio.py`, `call_monitor.py` and `tts_intelligibility.py`.
- [`examples/mantle-voice-banking-block-card-gpt/case-build/flux-short-reply/`](examples/mantle-voice-banking-block-card-gpt/case-build/flux-short-reply/): Deepgram Flux short-reply evidence. Saved Flux frames, their replay through Rasa's handler, and a patched replay: why a bare "Yes." can produce no user turn.
- [`tutorials/rasa-ai-team-casebook/`](tutorials/rasa-ai-team-casebook/): the AI team casebook, 62 case contracts (`examples/<case>.json`) that the case builds implement.
